### Gym grade: cool, contrasty, textured
<a id="colour-gym-grade"></a>

Slightly cooler or neutral, higher contrast, clarity/texture up for muscle definition, shadows lifted only a little, distracting signage colours desaturated, subtle vignette.

**How:** CapCut Adjust: contrast up, temperature slightly down, clarity/sharpen up, HSL desaturate signage colours, vignette low.

`edit` · formats: reel30, reel60, reel90, yt-short, carousel · niches: gym · our-take · from [SP](../sources/SP.md)

### Golden-hour travel grade
<a id="colour-golden-hour-grade"></a>

Warm temperature, lifted shadows, highlights pulled to keep the sun's disc, richer oranges/yellows, sky blues nudged to teal, light grain; don't oversaturate greens.

### Khandala grade recipe in ffmpeg
<a id="colour-khandala-ffmpeg-grade"></a>

Gentle S-curve, warm mids/highlights (R +0.03), saturation 1.10, contrast 1.04, light vignette.

**How:** ffmpeg: curves=preset=medium_contrast (gentle), colorbalance=rm=0.03:rh=0.03, eq=saturation=1.10:contrast=1.04, vignette=PI/5.

> gentle S-curve, warm mids/highlights (R +0.03), saturation 1.10, contrast 1.04, light vignette

`edit` · formats: reel30, yt-short, carousel · niches: travel · our-take · from [KH](../sources/KH.md)

### Moody grade: highlights down, blacks up
<a id="l10-moody-grade-recipe"></a>

His recommended look: curves pull the highlights down and lift the blacks, saturation down 15%, then a soft vignette. On-screen panel values: Highlights -35, Blacks +12, Saturation -15, Vignette -40. His own footage sits at mean luma ~25-28% with very low saturation and warm practical lamps.

**How:** CapCut/Edits Adjust: Highlights -35, Blacks +12, Saturation -15, Vignette -40. ffmpeg (our take): curves=all='0/0.05 0.75/0.66 1/0.88',eq=saturation=0.85,vignette=PI/5.

> Curves to pull the highlights down and lift the blacks. Saturation down 15%. Then a soft vignette.

`edit` · formats: reel30, reel60, reel90, yt-short, yt-long · niches: tech, travel · stated · from [L10](../sources/L10.md) · ⚠ [C32](../clashes.md#c32)
